messages:
marta_ops: Quick heads-up: running a focused spot-eviction warmup tomorrow 07:30 PT. Purpose: verify progressive eviction + cache warmup pattern and the approval cap on reserved provisioning. Low blast radius, <30 min.
alex_eng: thumbs up. can you outline the progressive plan?
marta_ops: Stage 1: drain ~20% of spot nodes (older generations) for 60s. wait 90s, Stage 2: drain additional ~10%. We only simulate preemption ordering and ensure routing policy promotes quantized variant if reserved cap hit.
priya: Success criteria I care about: p95 end-to-end < 1.25x baseline, error rate delta <= 1.5%, kv cache prefix hit >=60% within 90s post-failover.
ryan: Cost constraint: autoscaler must not request >140 reserved GPUs without 2 approvals. I wired the two-approver webhook; infra-bot will block otherwise.
kai_sre: I can script a gradual drain so pods re-schedule rather than all-at-once. also will capture scheduler event latency.
infra-bot: preflight check: dashboards up, alerting targets bound to #ops-spot-warmup, eviction-script v1.0 registered.
alex_eng: synthetic plan: sticky-key traffic at 45 RPS for 4m starting T-3m to stage 1. this should prime the KV cache.
priya: add a cold-start pulse at T=0 for 10s to see worst-case tail.
marta_ops: eviction snippet (random sample by age tag) - pushing copy to runbooks: 
```
nodes=( $(kubectl get nodes -l lifecycle=spot,age=old -o name) )
sample=$(python - <<'PY'
import sys,math
n=int(sys.argv[1]);print(max(1,math.floor(n*0.2)))
PY ${#nodes[@]})
shuf -e "${nodes[@]}" | head -n $sample | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl drain {} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
ryan: note: if websocket-heavy routes spike errors we should TTL-failover to degraded model, not drop traffic. document mapping.
kai_sre: I'll capture `kubectl get pods -o wide`, `kubectl describe node` snapshots and scheduler events into /tmp/warmup-artifacts then upload to S3.
devops-bot: synthetic-job created: synth-1793459123-45rps, sticky keys enabled.
infra-bot: approval webhook configured: >140 reserved GPUs -> block + notify #exec-approvals.
alex_eng: might be worth validating model-size routing cap (prevent large models moving to reserved). set to default 2x smaller capacity for the test.
priya: confirm we'll collect kvcache heatmap and prefix hit timeline. I have a small script to aggregate.
marta_ops: yep. priya captures heatmap, kai captures infra traces, alex posts dashboards. postmortem owner = alex_eng.
ryan: contingency: if autoscaler exceeds cap, webhook blocks and posts approvers. if approvals not given in 5m, routing should switch to quantized fallback model automatically.
kai_sre: logging: will timestamp events and include node-id lists for each stage. also capture cloud-provider spot-lifecycle events.
alex_eng: dashboard panels: p95/p99, error rate, kvcache.prefix_hit, request.routed_to_reserved_ratio, reserved.pool.pending_requests, scheduler.evictions.rate. posting link T-15m.
marta_ops: schedule: T-3m synth start, T0 stage 1 drain, T0+90s stage 2 drain, observe T0->T0+10m; rollback if any success gate breached.
priya: will run metrics collection and upload to s3://gameday-warmup/1793459123/
infra-bot: canary in staging passed earlier today.
alex_eng: small ask: include a short JSON artifact with node list and pre-eviction utilization for easier postmortem parsing.
kai_sre: done. I'll produce nodes.json before each stage.
marta_ops: final: keep this tight, low blast, lots of telemetry. T-07:30 PT tomorrow. :rocket: 
priya: :thumbsup:
ryan: on standby
alex_eng: see you there
infra-bot: reminder scheduled 1h and 5m before test.
